ops.new_text: \rev{Non-IID site heterogeneity reduced the ARI of each representation whose centralized ARI is above zero, and it did so unequally. Under IID federation across ten sites every representation retained essentially its centralized ARI, which validates the federated procedure (Table~\ref{tab:fed} and Fig.~\ref{fig:fed}). Under non-IID federation the hand-crafted features retained 92\% of their centralized ARI (0.644 to 0.591), while the ARI of ECGFounder fell from 0.885 to 0.612. The two means were close, 0.612 against 0.591, and they did not carry the same risk. Across the ten redrawn site partitions the seed bootstrap interval of the hand-crafted features was [0.546, 0.631] and their worst single partition still returned 0.455. The interval of ECGFounder was [0.382, 0.796], and three of its ten partitions fell to 0.132 or below, one of them to chance. This study takes the worst site draw as its deployment criterion, because a deployment meets a single site partition, and the mean over ten draws does not show how low that partition can fall. On that criterion the hand-crafted features retained more of their clustering ARI than ECGFounder under simulated site heterogeneity on PTB-XL.}
